Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) shows a curvilinear "scimitar" vein on the right side running parallel to the right heart border, accompanied by mediastinal deviation to the right and a hypoplastic right lung. The CT images confirm the presence of an abnormal systemic artery supplying the right lower lung inferiorly (Figure 1), which is characteristic of Scimitar syndrome.
